D5/S3/Observer/Linear/ExactTaylorObserva.signature: theorem exp_tail_le {𝕜 A : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 A] [CompleteSpace A] [NormOneClass A] (z : A) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ r) : ‖NormedSpace.exp z - ∑ k ∈ range n, ((k.factorial : 𝕜)⁻¹) • z ^ k‖ ≤ r ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp r
